kids: Children can cheer on the boats from the shoreline with noisemakers, tambourines and sleigh bells
The route is bridgeless and inside protected canal water
Santa's Cove is the parade start area
site: Four and a half mile lighted route
Commercial free, with no political or commercial entries
about: The organizers describe the parade as a Christmas gift to the community, from the community, and say it draws more total participation than any Christmas boat parade on the Gulf Coast.
The route has little two way traffic, few turns and no 180 degree turns, and the crowds stand about 50 feet from the boats along the canals.

Registered boaters can drop a boat off a day ahead and pick it up the day after, because the neighborhood offers free dock space on a first come, first served basis. Do not tie up to a private dock without written permission from the owner.
faq: What time does the parade start?
The organizers say the fleet sails at 6 PM on Saturday, December 19, 2026.
Is there a rain date?
No. The website says the parade runs rain or shine and there is no rain date.
Where can we watch from land?
The organizers say there are no designated public viewing areas, but spectators find spots along the 4.5 mile route, including near the Santa's Cove parade start. Do not park on the street.
Can we watch from a boat?
Yes, if you are securely anchored well away from the parade path with an all around anchor light, and children wear life jackets. Law enforcement enforces this.
Can our boat join in?
The website says all boaters near and far are welcome to register, and no commercial or political entries are allowed.

kids: Bounce houses and play snow for little ones
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at 6 PM to hear wish lists
site: Tree lighting countdown on the jumbotron
about: PG Light Up the Tree, Inc. is a nonprofit that funds and manages the annual community tree lighting during the first week of December and adds new decorations to the main street as its budget allows.
Evan Taylor Jones plays Stage 1 from 6:15 to 7:45 PM, a second stage runs from 7 to 8:25 PM, and country singer Josie Sal performs from 8:45 to 10:15 PM.
The tree lighting is at 8:30 PM with a countdown on the jumbotron and gentle snowflakes, and the raffle winner is announced live at 9 PM.
faq: What time does it start?
The schedule says the festivities kick off at 4 PM.
When does Santa arrive?
Santa and Mrs. Claus make their entrance at 6 PM.
When is the tree lit?
The schedule lists the tree lighting ceremony at 8:30 PM. Some visitor sites print a different time, so use the organizer schedule.
Does it cost anything?
The organizers say the event is open to all at no cost to attendees.
Where is it?
In Downtown Punta Gorda, at West Marion Avenue and Taylor Street.

kids: Photos with the Grinch at the photo area just inside the main entrance
A Santa visit on Sunday, November 29 from noon to 4 PM
Free admission and free parking at the village
site: Waterfront setting with dining and shops
Part of the Holiday Festival of Lights season
about: Fishermen's Village runs a Holiday Festival of Lights from November 15 to December 31, 2026, with more than one million lights and decorations inside and outside the village, and the Grinch and Santa visits are part of that season.

The village's holiday lighting night on November 14 included Santa and Mrs. Claus arriving by fire truck, Elf on the Shelf photos and the Grinch with Cindy Lou Who, and the remaining visit dates carry the characters through December 19.
The village is at 1200 W. Retta Esplanade, and it says outdoor events are subject to weather and schedule changes.
faq: Which dates is the Grinch there?
November 27, December 4, 5, 11, 18 and 19, 2026.
What times are the Grinch visits?
Fridays from 5 PM to 8 PM and Saturdays from 4 PM to 7 PM.
When can we see Santa?
The village lists Visits with Santa on Sunday, November 29 from noon to 4 PM inside the main entrance.
Does it cost anything?
The village says its events are free with free parking.
Where do we find them?
At the photo area just inside the main entrance of Fishermen's Village, 1200 W. Retta Esplanade, Punta Gorda.
